annotations.title: Verify & Settle On-Chain USDT/USDC Invoice Payment

description: Verify and settle a confirmed on-chain USDT/USDC transaction hash (`tx_hash`) against a PayGate `invoice_id` via live JSON-RPC receipt log inspection. Idempotent state-changing operation (unlimited free calls, anti-replay enforced): confirms recipient address, token contract, and minimum USD amount, transitions the invoice to `paid`, extends recurring `subscription_expires_at` if configured, and dispatches any configured webhook. Returns JSON with `ok` (boolean), `already_paid` (boolean), and updated `invoice` object.

invoice_id.description: Unique PayGate invoice identifier returned by `create_usdt_invoice` (e.g. `inv_a1b2c3d4e5f6`).

tx_hash.description: Confirmed on-chain transaction hash (`0x...` 66-char hex on EVM chains or base58 signature on Solana) transferring USDT/USDC to the invoice's `merchant_wallet`.

name: verify_usdt_invoice
